name: hud_check_icons
description: The strip shows the next wave's checks, each glyph with the portrait of the creep that brings it (design 5.7 and 2.3): before wave 1 Swarm (Froth) with the Gourdling; in the window before wave 5 the Winged glyph (Spindrift) with the Duskmoth's portrait; before wave 6 Armored with the Thornback and the Bristlesow as its boss; during a wave, that wave's own. Hovering the wave lists every wave still to come as rows of glyphs and portraits.

steps.msg: the classic match's first wave, eight Gourdlings and nothing else, is a swarm
before wave 1: Swarm, with the Gourdling beside it
before wave 4: Armored with the Thornback only (its eight Gourdlings are no pack)
in the window before wave 5: the Winged glyph with the Duskmoth
drawn from the painted Spindrift glyph and the Duskmoth's portrait, on the strip
the portrait sits beside its glyph, on the wave's line

steps.assert: node('WaveList').visible and node('WaveRows').get_child_count() == 8 and node('WaveRow5') != null and node('WaveRow12') != null
steps.msg: hovering the wave lists the waves to come, 5 to 12, one row each
each row shows its checks' glyphs: all four on wave 11, Winged alone on wave 5
and goes when the pointer leaves
before wave 6: Armored with the Thornback, and the Bristlesow's portrait as its boss
during wave 5 the strip shows that wave's own checks
